description: This file defines the ValidationException class, a custom exception used within the OpenMRS API to handle fatal validation errors, including mechanisms to associate Spring Errors objects and provide detailed messages.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, indicating validation failures during OpenMRS API operations, with support for associating Errors objects and various constructors for flexibility.

methods.name: ValidationException()
methods.description: Default constructor for ValidationException, generally not recommended for use.

methods.name: ValidationException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing to set a custom message describing the validation error.

methods.name: ValidationException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that sets a message and propagates an underlying cause.

methods.name: ValidationException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps another exception as the cause.

methods.name: ValidationException(Errors errors)
methods.description: Constructor associating a Spring Errors object with the exception.

methods.name: ValidationException(String message, Errors errors)
methods.description: Constructor setting a message and associating Errors object.

methods.name: getErrors()
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the associated Errors object.

methods.name: setErrors(Errors errors)
methods.description: Setter method to assign an Errors object to this exception.
